candidate_selection.rule: Stratified by company type; include every reviewed hard-tech company meeting at least one of: funding >= CNY 200m, new factory opened, flagship platform/product launch with concrete metrics, or scoped strategic partnership. Selection agent was prohibited from job searches.

freeze_rule: After the pre-prediction seal, do not change evidence, prompt, ontology, matcher, thresholds or candidate universe. Run and freeze predictions before any future-job label search.
